title: Installation
subtitle: React bindings for qortex-form
description: Install qortex-form-react and optional query/store peers for binders.
content: Core React hooks ship in the main entry. Query/store binders are separate entry points with optional peer dependencies.

code.code:
npm install qortex-form-react@0.1.0-alpha.0
# pulls qortex-form as a dependency
